description: Perl script for generating ARM assembly code for big number operations (addition and subtraction) in BoringSSL's FIPS module, specifically for ARMv8 architecture.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Assembly function for adding two big numbers represented as arrays of BN_ULONG.

methods.name: bn_sub_words
methods.description: Assembly function for subtracting two big numbers represented as arrays of BN_ULONG.
